page.layout: One block only: the front board of a leather binding, blind-tooled with a decorative frame. Inside the frame is a central panel with a figure of a bearded man in a cap or mitre, holding a staff. Below the figure is a three-line tooled inscription in a rectangular panel. No printed page is visible.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The scan shows the front cover of the binding, not a book page. The three-line inscription under the figure is tooled into the leather, not printed, and is too worn and shadowed to read reliably, so it is not transcribed here. Its capitals appear to read roughly "CASTAT VLI... MAGNAFOR / MAST... ORBLAEDPLACTATIA / ...". Treat these as unverified. Upper and lower rectangular panels are blank. Corners and edges show wear and cracking.
